text:
elaine: Heads up — ran the nightly fused-attn benchmarks and saw a 4-7% P95 regression for seq512 on flash-fused when warmup traffic is present.
max: Ugh, on which config? dedicated racks or hosted?
elaine: dedicated, A100s, 1 shard per GPU, model=redwood-m-8k, batcher=adaptive-ss, batching window=6ms.
jin: Any traces? Could be KV cache warmup causing thrash on the fused kernel path.
elaine: Attached a short repro and nvprof snippet:
```
repro: python perf/run_batcher_repro.py --model m-8k --seq 512 --warmup 20 --qps 80 --kernel flash-fused
--metrics: nvprof summary
sm_efficiency: 62%
memory_throughput: 680 GB/s
shared_mem_util: 78%
warp_serialize: 3%
L2_cache_reads: 1.9e9
KV-cache-hits: 0.61 on warmup, 0.93 steady
```
ryan: KV-cache hit rate jumping from .6 -> .93 screams warmup eviction. Where are we pinning KV buffers?
elaine: We currently do a dynamic KV pool that grows on demand and uses LRU eviction per-GPU; when kernel switches to flash-fused we increase SM sharedmem usage which reduces resident KV pages -> extra DRAM traffic.
perf-bot: perf-alert: flash-fused P95_regression +5% on nightly (link: https://perf.redwood/1887654321) :warning:
max: Interesting — so it's an interaction: kernel choice -> higher SM shared mem -> less room for KV cache -> more DRAM reads -> memory bandwidth saturation -> tail latency hit.
jin: Can we replicate with synthetic pacing to isolate batching heuristics vs KV sizing? Suggest: force batcher window=0 (immediate) and prewarm KV fully before traffic.
elaine: I ran those: immediate batching reduces P95 but throughput drops 8%. Prewarm KV brings hits to 0.98 and P95 back to baseline. So two levers: batcher window and KV residency.
ryan: For a proper fix we could: 1) Add a kernel-aware KV admission policy (reduce evictions when fused kernel selected), 2) Adjust pipeline to move some KV buffers to L2-favoring placement (experiment with cuMemAdvise), or 3) tweak tiling to lower sharedmem footprint on fused kernel.
max: Quick mitigation: set a per-model min_kv_resident_pages based on kernel profile. Low-risk and fast.
jin: Agree. Also log a new metric: kernel_sharedmem_pressure and kv_eviction_rate so we can alert earlier.
elaine: I'll open a small PR for min_kv_resident_pages with a default of +20% for flash-fused, and add a config flag to opt-in per-deployment. Will post numbers.
perf-bot: deploy-plan-suggested: canary to 10% traffic on dedicated-only nodes first.
ryan: After PR, let's run fused vs paged microbench with different tiling configs — need numbers on occupancy vs mem throughput.
elaine: Copying results here after PR: prewarm + min_resident -> P95 diff -0.5% vs baseline, throughput -1%. Shipping the PR now. :shipit: 
max: Nice. Longer term, jin and I will prototype a tiler variant with reduced smem per-thread and measure kernel latency overhead.
jin: Will do. Putting benchmark plan in the perf board.
elaine: thanks all — will follow up with perf graphs in the canary. :thumbsup:
